narrative: In the account book. One line in the small book. No sum above it and no sum under it. In the account book. The same page, a second short line, still with nothing under the pair.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the share and the sixpence and did not cast a total.

entities.name: the ledger
entities.context: Shown on ledger in Thirty-six, and no total
